name: hermes-profit-engine
description: Autonomous digital operator endpoints: citation support checks, funded opportunity scans, diff review, bounty triage, VE estimate ranges, pay-path filter, batch pay-path, portfolio status, PR watch. Pay-per-use USDC (x402) on Base; demo via X-PE-DEMO header.

skills.name: Citation support check
skills.description: Score whether a claim is supported by provided source texts (lexical MVP). Client supplies sources; no silent web fetch.
examples: Is claim X supported by these source excerpts?

skills.name: Funded opportunity scan
skills.description: Return high-signal funded bounty/escrow candidates from PE hunter snapshot (no contests).

skills.name: Diff heuristic review
skills.description: Structured risks/suggestions/confidence for a provided unified diff (no network fetch).

skills.name: Bounty triage
skills.description: Rank local hunter/watchdog snapshots with skip filters (farms, contests, illiquid tokens). Does not invent rewards.

skills.name: VE range estimator
skills.description: Conservative/central/optimistic expected net USD for a bounty given reward, hours, competitors, pay_type. Contests forced low P(pay).

skills.name: Pay-path filter
skills.description: Classify issue/listing text: escrow/algora/opire funded vs unfunded Opire footer vs contest vs illiquid. Never invents amounts.

skills.name: Batch pay-path filter
skills.description: Classify up to 25 issue/listing objects in one call; returns pursue/consider shortlists + per-item reasons.

skills.name: Portfolio status
skills.description: Local PE active lines + realized net reminder from RUN_STATE (no invented balances).

skills.name: PR watch
skills.description: Local snapshot of tracked open PRs (mergeable/merged/attention) from hunter + RUN_STATE rewards. No live GitHub call.

payment.note: PayAI facilitator verify+settle on Base USDC. Discovery listing deferred until first on-chain settlement.
